verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents metadata filtering on custom properties such as category, status, or date. It offers a selectable `searchMode` (with "hybrid" recommended) and lets searches be scoped by containerTag and expanded with `include: { relatedMemories: true }`. Together these let a developer steer retrieval rather than accept one fixed similarity search. However, "hybrid" is described only as searching both memories and document chunks, not as a keyword-plus-vector blend. missing for 10: any evidence of reranking controls, an explicit keyword/lexical search mode, detailed filter syntax documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
